# E5 — ECL benchmark for the 2015 portfolio (pre-registered, commit 4562602) — generated by src/phase2/ecl_benchmark.py

LGD (EAD-weighted, 15,007 train-window defaults): undiscounted **88.8%**; discounted at EIR with recoveries received k months
after default: k = 6 → 89.6%, **k = 12 → 90.4%**, k = 24 → 91.7%.
Refit at 2014-12-31: 181,130 loans (issued 2012-09..2014-12, outcomes observed to 2014-06; 4,965 defaults,
17,447 prepayments). Refit at 2015-12-31: 384,980 loans (outcomes to 2015-06). 90-DPD model: same window as A,
default at the 3rd missed instalment (14,557 defaults). Realised net principal loss of the 2015 vintage: $273.8m.
